description: The certified lockstep set: these tool versions were verified TOGETHER. Re-certified 2026-07-28. All five category5_baie_dore_001 candidates now prove the mission spine: 0 of 31 legs failing on every one, 0 stranded anchors, 0 anchors without standing room, against a baseline that morning of four of four failing with nine legs each -- and seed 5421 had never been walktested at all. Four of the five come back ok=true. Seed 5017 does not, and the reason is the walktest working: its path proofs all pass and all four simulated walkers then stop at the same point, (20.5, 0.9, -2.7), on the same leg, having reached 8 of 16 targets. A route the polygon graph says exists that a physical capsule cannot walk is the collision-trap class PASS 2 was built for, and no path query can see it. Two defects, in series. A marker is where a thing IS; an anchor is where a body has to stand to use it, and the pipeline had never distinguished them, so sixteen of twenty-one anchors were demanding walkable routes onto cashier counters and into vault blocks (Lot 0.29.0). And LT_ROUTE_NEVER_COMPLETED -- Laser Tag reporting a navigability fact from a firefight -- blocked one candidate, which under fail-fast meant that candidate's walktest never dispatched at all while its stable out/ kept a seven-hour-old report that read as a current answer (Level Factory 0.20.0). NOT covered by this set: WALKTEST_ENFORCED is still False, so the walktest WARNS rather than blocks -- navigability is currently ungated, because the Laser Tag route gate was removed before its replacement was switched on. Flipping it is the next decision and every candidate has now been measured by it. The existing Phase 4 library has still never been walktested, and portfolio approval still awaits the visual-score art leg.

deli_counter.note: owns the collision contract; agent_contract.json is the source the Lot clearance math derives from

laser_tag.note: pinned from 0.8.0 onward. It reported UNKNOWN until then not because the addon had no version -- plugin.cfg always declared one -- but because the repo had no root VERSION file, which is the only place verify-manifest looks. The two are mirrors and the lasertag lint job fails if they disagree. Cache invalidation still rests on content, not on this line: the Level Factory adapter hashes addons/laser_tag_tool into fingerprint_inputs, so an addon edited without a bump still invalidates.

level_factory.note: 0.14.0 removed the scheduler's resume pre-skip. 0.15.0 added the walktest_navqa stage. 0.18.0 splits one anchor code into four, because a room that did not bake, an anchor that connects to nothing, a marker inside the furniture and a marker sealed behind a breach panel send a reader to four different places. 0.18.1 makes _finding coerce `location`. 0.19.0 adds WALKTEST_ANCHOR_BEHIND_BARRIER. 0.20.0 stops LT_ROUTE_NEVER_COMPLETED blocking -- the walktest measures that claim directly and Laser Tag's number is confounded by stuck bots, team wipes and a 180 s clock -- and adds RunSummary.never_dispatched, printed by cmd_run, because fail-fast leaves jobs unrun whose out/ still holds the previous run's artifacts and nothing distinguished that from success.

lot.note: cover clearance and lane pinch are derived from the Deli Counter agent contract, not hardcoded. 0.28.0 emits nav-QA anchors on their room's FLOOR (read from the room record, not derived from story x 4) and merges markers that coincide once dropped; the director searches the anchor's own storey plane for standing room, with a band that is asymmetric on purpose -- a body height down, one max_climb plus a voxel up. 0.29.0 resolves an anchor whose nearest standing room is on a component nothing reaches to the nearest CONNECTED one, bounded by the same 6 m, and reports both distances; it also unions clusters on MUTUAL reachability, because arrival is judged within SNAP_MAX of the destination and one directed edge had been enough.

pipeline.note: Phase 4 complete: 100 configs / 36 families / 20 missions / 8 heroes registered, engine-gated; approval awaits visual scores

pixelcoat.note: version lives in pixelcoat/version.py, not a root VERSION file
